content_sections.heading: RITES Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: 5 posts are notified across 3 Vacancy Codes, with the following category-wise distribution. The written test for all three posts will be conducted on the same date and time - candidates must ensure their eligibility for the appropriate post/vacancy before applying.

content_sections.heading: RITES Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The period of training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship, or PhD research experience is NOT counted as part of experience. Apprenticeship training (as per the Apprenticeship Act 1961) in the relevant discipline is considered towards the minimum post-qualification experience, subject to other eligibility conditions. UR/EWS category candidates (and SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts) should have a first-class degree, or minimum 60% marks in the qualifying degree. Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD, as applicable) should have at least 50% marks in the qualifying degree for consideration against reserved posts. The candidate's degree must be recognised by AICTE, from a University incorporated by an Act of Central/State legislature in India, or another institution established by an Act of Parliament or deemed a University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956. Sections A & B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India), treated as equivalent to a Degree by the Government of India and recognised by AICTE, are also accepted. Where a certificate/marksheet does not indicate percentage or division, the applicant must provide the university/institution's official conversion formula from CGPA/DGPA; if no such formula exists, an authorised undertaking must be submitted, and a minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale will be treated as 60%. Candidates from Central/State Govt./PSUs/Autonomous Organisations on IDA/CDA pay scales must have a total experience of 8 years (for Sr. Manager) and must have worked at least 2 years in the IDA pay scale of ₹50,000–₹1,60,000 or the CDA pay scale equivalent to Level 9 of the 7th CPC pay matrix. For those on non-IDA/CDA pay scales (State PSUs, Autonomous Organisations, PSBs, Public Sector Insurance Companies, other Statutory Bodies), equivalence is determined by comparing the maximum basic pay in their scale against the relevant IDA/CDA scale. The 2-year residency requirement in the immediate lower scale does not apply to candidates already in the same or a higher pay scale as the advertised post. Candidates from the private sector or other organisations must have a total experience of 8 years and an annual CTC of at least ₹20.16 lakh as on the last date for submission of the application. The criteria apply to the candidate's latest/current organisation.

rows.minimum_qualification: Full-time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering AND Master's Degree in Marine Engineering & Management / Ocean Structures or Engineering / Structural Engineering or equivalent/synonymous/similar qualification
rows.relevant_work_experience: Minimum 8 years' professional experience in structural and marine engineering design, of which minimum 5 years' hands-on experience in design, analysis and detailing of marine and coastal structures, including Quay walls, jetties, dolphins, breakwaters, berthing structures, dry docks, slipways, ship lifts, etc.

rows.relevant_work_experience: Minimum 2 years' experience in design/analysis of marine structures (jetties, dolphins, quay walls, breakwaters)

rows.minimum_qualification: Full-time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering AND Master's Degree in Coastal Engineering / Marine Engineering & Management / Ocean Structures or Engineering or equivalent/synonymous/similar qualification
rows.relevant_work_experience: Minimum 2 years' professional experience in coastal/ocean engineering-related projects/numerical modelling of coastal processes

content_sections.heading: RITES Ltd Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: 125 objective-type questions, 1 mark each, for a duration of 2.5 hours. No negative marking - no marks deducted for incorrect answers. PwBD candidates are eligible for 50 minutes' compensatory time. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for UR/EWS; 45% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD against reserved posts. Based on written test results and the number of vacancies, submitted documents are scrutinized by RITES, and shortlisted candidates are called for interview preceded by verification of original documents. Any deficiency in documents will be notified on the website along with the interview call list; candidates must produce documents fulfilling the deficiency at document verification, or their candidature will be rendered ineligible. Candidates are called for interview in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies. Weightage: Written Test – 60%; Interview – 40% (Technical & Professional Proficiency – 30%, Personality/Communication/Competency – 10%). Total: 100%. Minimum qualifying marks in interview: 60% for UR/EWS; 50% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD against reserved posts. There is no minimum qualifying marks requirement in the aggregate. Candidates may appear for the selection process in either Hindi or English. Based on requirement and RITES' discretion, the written test and/or interview may be conducted from Regional Offices, intimated via the respective call letters. Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being found medically fit in the Medical Examination conducted as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness for the relevant post.

faq.question: Q1. What is RITES Ltd Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by RITES Limited, a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways, for 5 posts of Sr. Manager and Assistant Manager in the Ports & Waterways and Coastal Modelling disciplines, under Vacancy Codes RG/26-R1/25, RG/27-R1/25, and RG/28-R1/25.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RITES Ltd Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 total vacancies: 1 Sr. Manager (Ports & Waterways), 2 Assistant Manager (Ports & Waterways), and 2 Assistant Manager (Coastal Modelling).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RITES Ltd Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application and fee payment is 08.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for RITES Ltd Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering plus a relevant Master's Degree (Marine Engineering & Management/Ocean Structures/Structural Engineering for Ports & Waterways posts, or Coastal Engineering/Marine Engineering & Management/Ocean Structures for Coastal Modelling), along with the specified post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RITES Ltd Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 38 years for Sr. Manager (Ports & Waterways) and 32 years for both Assistant Manager posts, as on 08.10.2026, with relaxation of up to 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC-NCL candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RITES Ltd Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹600 plus taxes for General/OBC candidates and ₹300 plus taxes for EWS/SC/ST/PwBD candidates; the fee for SC/ST/PwBD candidates is refunded upon participation in the selection process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RITES Ltd Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Written Test (125 objective questions, 2.5 hours, no negative marking), Document Scrutiny, and an Interview, with a weightage of 60% (Written Test) and 40% (Interview).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for RITES Ltd Sr. Manager and Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: The pay scale is ₹60,000–₹1,80,000 for Sr. Manager (Ports & Waterways) and ₹40,000–₹1,40,000 for both Assistant Manager posts.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply online for RITES Ltd Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through the Career Section of http://www.rites.com, fill the registration form, upload required documents, pay the application fee, and submit before 08.10.2026.

faq.answer: The written test is tentatively scheduled for 25.10.2026, and will be held on the same date and time for all three posts.
